title: English Practice Quiz 0854
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Data and Record Management: What is a data validation rule used for?
options: Check entered information against defined conditions
questions.explanation: Validation prevents invalid or inconsistent entries.

questions.question: Data and Record Management: What is a duplicate record?
options: A second entry representing the same item or person

questions.question: Data and Record Management: What does an audit trail establish?
options: Who changed a record and when
questions.explanation: An audit trail records actions and changes.

questions.question: Data and Record Management: How should a paper record be corrected?
options: Follow the approved procedure and preserve traceability

questions.question: Data and Record Management: What does a retention period specify?
options: How long a record must be kept
questions.explanation: Retention rules define how long records are stored.

questions.question: Data and Record Management: Which file name is easiest to identify?
questions.explanation: A descriptive name with date and version is identifiable.

questions.question: Data and Record Management: How should access permissions be granted?
options: According to a person's role and need
questions.explanation: Role-based access limits information to those who need it.

questions.question: Data and Record Management: How should a data backup be managed?
options: Perform and test according to policy
Store only on the same failing device

questions.question: Data and Record Management: How should a confidential record be handled?
Data and Record Management: What should happen before deleting a record?
questions.explanation: Deletion must follow retention and authorisation rules.
